text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Did you hear?
During this year's summer training camp,
they're holding a "Deserted Island Survival
Contest" on our day off!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I saw the flyer... but what ...
Yeah, I saw the flyer... but what ...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
The judging points are "Peace of Mind,"
"Safety," and
"A Survival Experience That Makes Everyone
Envious," it says.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When I hear the word survival,
there's no way I can just sit on the
sidelines!
Hey Trainer—Give it a try with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
on our rest day during summer training
camp,
Daring Heart and I made our way to a nearby
deserted island.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we are!
I'd love to just soak in this gorgeous scenery,
but...
choice_data_list: First things first, we need to sec...
First things first, we need to sec...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Survival is all about time management!
Just like we planned last night,
let's get right down to business!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We're in luck!
There's a cave that's just the right size.
Let's set up here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We passed a stream on the way here for water,
so... next is securing food.
Trainer,
could you gather some branches and vines we
can use as cord?
choice_data_list: Branches and vines?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We'll make a simple trap and set it up
beforehand.
It looks like they cleared all the necessary
permissions for us, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Once that's done,
we'll forage for ingredients in the hills
and do a flotsam check!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey! Heads up, dropping them down!
choice_data_list: A-All right, got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud, thud, thud!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice catch!
That secures our vitamins and dessert!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this island is packed with great
driftwood.
...I'm done! There,
the hammock is finished!
Go ahead and try it out.
choice_data_list: A-All right... Here goes nothing!
A-All right... Here goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steeling my resolve,
I laid down on the hammock
Daring Heart had crafted from beach
flotsam.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: How is it? Comfortable?
choice_data_list: It's beyond amazing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that!
Once you've caught your breath,
let's go check the river traps!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fish, fruit...
Water's boiling nicely, and...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... If I do say so myself,
this is flawless!
...Okay, I'm going to go wash my hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her walk off toward the freshwater
spring,
I surveyed our impeccably arranged base
camp.
choice_data_list: (It's flawless, but... is this rea...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Food and shelter are both perfect.
There isn't a single flaw to point out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However,
one of the judging criteria is "A Survival
Experience That Makes Everyone Envious."
...Maybe being simply "perfect" won't cut
it—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm back——Hey, what's up?
Your brow is all furrowed, you know?
choice_data_list: Huh?! No, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Really?
choice_data_list: Urgh... Well, I might just be over...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up sharing my thoughts with her.
Namely,
that "we might need an extra creative touch
if we want to win"...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You really are the absolute best!
You're fire!
choice_data_list: Well, I might just be overthinking...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, you're totally right!
What they're looking for
isn't just "perfection," but a "survival
experience that makes everyone envious!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this!
Now that that's settled,
we have no time to lose.
Let's go gather materials!
choice_data_list: Materials?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to decorate!
This entire base camp!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Flowers...
and maybe we can put campfires inside empty
cans to make lanterns!
Either way,
I want to make it gorgeous and emotional!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To take the win...
the real challenge starts now!
Are you ready?
choice_data_list: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look... sea glass!
Let's gather a whole bunch and arrange them
on the table!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what are you making?
choice_data_list: I thought wearing this would look ...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea! Hey, let's make another one!
It'll look even more fabulous if we match!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Stylish and comfortable.
No matter who looks at it,
this is a base camp to be envious of!
choice_data_list: It really turned into something lu...
It really turned into something lu...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh!
Now all that's left is to take our submission
photo right here... and done!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, we have to put these on!
Same to you too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the Deserted Island Survival Contest came
to a successful close...

text_block_list.name: Survival Judge
text_block_list.text:
And the glorious winner of the Deserted
Island Survival Contest is...
...the Daring Heart duo! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Survival Judge
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize is——
the "Perfect Survival Kit"!
Be sure to put it to good use in your
training!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Perfect Survival Kit"...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, ahahaha!
...Looks like our next rest day is going to
be on a deserted island too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing dinner,
the two of us headed down to the shore for
a proper celebration.
choice_data_list: Phew... It's so peaceful out here.
Phew... It's so peaceful out here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Hehe, feeling relieved?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, you know.
I'm always dragging you along to all these
noisy, crowded places.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Deep down,
you probably prefer quiet places like
this.
...Whenever you don't feel like it,
it's totally okay to just say no, alright?
choice_data_list: I don't mind at all. It lets me ex...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And above all,
whenever I'm with Daring Heart—
choice_data_list: I completely forget about how bori...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What?
Boring... you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded, gazing out at the sea.
...Always overthinking everything,
hesitant to take action.
Whenever I'm with her,
that boring part of myself—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —You've got to be kidding!
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding me!
There's hardly anyone out there as fun to
be around as you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your world is always bursting with mysteries
and questions.
So many wonders that my own eyes would
completely miss.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I love that world of yours.
I love hearing you talk all about it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You get it?
That curiosity and passion for discovery of
yours...
has completely stolen my heart!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?
choice_data_list: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was stunned.
I never imagined Daring Heart
felt that way about me...
choice_data_list: Heart, you really are incredible.
Heart, you truly are incredible.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Not really.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's my line,
don't you think... my heart?
